messages:
jas_fin: Flagging INV-10014 (OligoHealth)  payment failed. Gateway notes: issuer decline 'card_not_supported_for_ecommerce' 

marcos_ae: On call with customer. They use a corporate prepaid card (virtual) that the issuer disables for online merchant category codes outside EU. Need them in this week for trial.

payments-bot: Webhook: gateway=Adyen, decline_code=card_not_supported_ecom, attempt_id=at_242345. Auto-retry scheduled in 8h (rty_242345).

rina_support: Customer says procurement cant change card settings quickly. Theyre willing to do bank transfer but procurement requires our wire instructions plus invoice reference to route payment.

jas_fin: Two quick operational asks: 1) pause the scheduled retry to avoid duplicate attempts if they wire, 2) provide wire details and KYC checklist.

ops_ryan: Pausing auto-retry now. Also logging decline event under telemetry key `decline_reason=card_not_supported_ecom`. We should capture `card_funding_type=prepaid` and `card_country`.

marcos_ae: Customer (olga_cust) prefers Plaid ACH if we support their EU bank via our PSD2 flows; otherwise wire. Olga, can you confirm bank country and whether they can authenticate via bank login?

olga_cust: We use BNP Paribas (France) HQ but our US entity handles vendor payments. We dont want to do wire if Plaid requires EU bank redirect, that might be sticky. Would prefer bank transfer with reference INV-10014.

rina_support: Drafting wire instructions and KYC: 

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Coast Bank
Account: 556677889
Routing (ABA): 021000021
SWIFT/BIC: FCBUS33
Reference: INV-10014 / OligoHealth
KYC required: corporate registration, PO, remittance email screenshot
```

marcos_ae: I'll offer to waive the $40 manual-processing fee this once to avoid friction (pilot incentive).

payments-bot: Reminder: when wire posts, mark paid with `payments:mark-paid INV-10014 txn=<bank_txn_id>` and include `manual_waiver=pilot-waive-40` to annotate ledger.

ops_ryan: Action items: 1) Add a small UX hint on invoice page for prepaid/virtual cards: "If payment card is prepaid/virtual, some issuers block e-commerce — try bank transfer or Plaid." 2) Add telemetry for `card_funding_type=prepaid` declines for 60 days.

jas_fin: Confirming Ive added invoice tag `manual-wire-pending` and paused auto-retry. Rina, send wire instructions and request KYC docs; cc accounting.

rina_support: Sent message to customer with wire instructions and upload link. Customer replied: "Wire will be initiated today, will send receipt."

marcos_ae: Great. Once received, finance will post payment and untag hold. Also follow up to ensure we track frequency of prepaid-block declines for pricing/product insight.

payments-bot: Note: if the customer later wants to try Plaid, we support EUR bank login via our EU PSP; create manual_collect job `manual_collect_10014_plaid` for that path.
